messages:
Ava Reynolds: FYI — LumaHealth pre-QBR: overnight embed job blew past expected traffic, retainer consumption spiked. Can we map fixes + numbers for the deck?
Diego Morales: saw ~78k embed tokens between 01:00-03:30 UTC, endpoint /v1/embeddings/batch-large. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/usage/lumahealth (internal)
Rina Patel: flagging renewal watch -> amber. They want 30/60/90 burn scenarios and clarity on mitigations.
Diego Morales: quick actions: 1) add spend alert at 75% of retainer 2) cap batch_size 512->128 for 48h 3) enable prefix/KV caching for top 50 queries. low-effort.
Diego Morales: alert snippet to paste into Console -> Alerts:
``
resource: customer/lumahealth
metric: credits_used
window: 24h
threshold: 75%
notify: #cs-ops, #eng-oncall
action: temp-cap embed_batch_size=128
```
Ava Reynolds: Rina — can you capture enablement gaps? I'll run a 3-question poll with the customer tomorrow AM; need poll summary for QBR.
Rina Patel: on it. Also requesting Eng: please validate q4_0 quantization perf impact and estimate cost delta so we can present numbers.
CS-Alert-Bot: alert created: lumahealth credits_used 75% threshold (1998803600)  notified #cs-ops.
Ava Reynolds: Owners:
- Diego: deploy temp throttle + caching (ETA 90m)
- Diego: perf validation for q4_0 (ETA EOD)
- Rina: assemble 30/60/90 scenarios + capture enablement feedback (ETA tomorrow AM)
- Ava: run poll & prepare QBR slide (ETA tomorrow AM)
